versions.name: Thorn Ring
versions.text: Whenever you cast a spell, gain counters equal to its cost. If this reaches 9+ counters, spend 9 to add a 4/4 Ice Crystal to your hand.

versions.name: Thorn Ring
versions.text: Whenever you cast a spell, gain counters equal to its cost. Turn end: If this has 10+ counters, spend all counters to summon an Ice Crystal.
